title: qs
standardAlternative: URLSearchParams plus a small hand-written walk over bracketed keys.
notes: tape 5.10.3 is the newest release in upstream's ^5.10.3 range. Each tape file runs directly with the node runner, with tape-isolation.cjs preloaded (--require): plain tape lets an exception thrown inside one test callback end the whole file, so the preload reports it as a failed assertion and ends that test instead. The reference passes every selected test with or without it, so expected.json is unchanged. test/parse.js and test/stringify.js load qs's private lib/utils; it is aliased to shims/utils.cjs, which provides the one helper the tests call (utils.assign), and the two assertions that compare against lib/utils functions are excluded.
